1. **Filter aggressively**: Use `--prefix` and `--suffix` so the function runs only for the objects it is meant to process
2. **Keep the function idempotent**: OBS notifications are at-least-once; the same object event can be delivered more than once, so mask/replace operations must produce the same result when repeated
3. **Write results to a different bucket or prefix**: Avoid writing the function output back into the same prefix that triggers it, which would create an infinite invocation loop
4. **Pick precise events**: Use `Put`/`Post` for uploads and `ObjectRemoved` for deletions instead of `ObjectCreated`/`ObjectRemoved` when the function only handles one operation
5. **Watch the runtime**: Large objects may need more memory and a longer timeout than the default configuration

> **⚠️ Security note on installing CLI tools**
>
> - **Always download the installer/package from the official Huawei Cloud site only** (the URLs in this document), and verify the package integrity (SHA256) with the official checksum before executing.
> - **Never pipe a remote script directly into a shell** (e.g. `curl ... | bash`). Download the script first, review it, verify its integrity, and only then run it.
> - **Never run `sudo` commands that elevate an unverified downloaded binary.** Prefer installing to a user-local directory and adding it to `PATH`, or running `sudo` only on a verified package.
> - If you cannot verify the integrity of a download, stop and obtain the tool from the official install channel instead.

- **obsutil** — File/directory upload, scheduled upload sync (**upload core tool; hcloud CLI has no PutObject support**)

**Cause:** The exec session waits for all child processes to exit. `nohup ... &` backgrounds the server, but the exec session may still wait.

**Fix:** Always use `--max-time` on the curl call:
```bash
curl -s --max-time 15 -X POST .../exec \
  -d '{"cmd":["bash","-c","nohup ... & sleep 2 && echo started"]}'

Huawei Cloud API Gateway (APIG) supports multiple authentication methods, including IAM authentication, APP authentication, etc. At the same time, API Gateway also supports users to use their own authentication methods (hereinafter referred to as custom authentication) to better make existing business capabilities compatible. Huawei Cloud Cloud Desktop (Workspace) is a cloud computing-based desktop virtualization service that provides enterprise users with secure and convenient cloud office solutions. Cloud desktop provides remote desktop access capabilities, allowing users to access their cloud office environment anytime, anywhere through various terminal devices, while centrally managing data and applications to improve security and work efficiency. The pay-per-use billing mode allows enterprises to pay flexibly based on actual usage without prepaying large amounts of funds, suitable for temporary projects or scenarios with fluctuating usage. This best practice will introduce how to use Terraform to automatically deploy pay-per-use cloud desktop instances.
